summary: The recorded base reproduced the original ordering defect in alloc_extend and alloc_decode: all three insufficient-capacity cases returned None only after indexing the mocked Triton launcher. At the exact candidate commit, the candidate regression, related lazy-release tests, independent boundary cases, and real gfx950 success/OOM paths passed. The source change moves the existing capacity calculations and checks ahead of output allocation and kernel launch while preserving staged-page merging. No native source changed.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: 3 OOM-ordering failures and 3 passing boundary tests; each failing OOM case indexed its mocked kernel launcher once.
Candidate regression at the exact SHA: 6 passed, covering computed and supplied extend demand, decode OOM, exact capacity, and staged-page merging.
Independent cases: multi-request extend exceeds capacity by one, zero-new-page extend still launches, and decode demand remains OOM after staged-page merge; all passed.
Focused regression plus related staged/lazy release behavior: 8 passed.
One MI350X/gfx950: real Triton extend/decode outputs matched independent CPU references; insufficient-capacity extend/decode returned None with zero launcher indexing.

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950 capability (9,5), torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015. Raw output is in raw/candidate-gpu-reproducer.txt.

native_rebuild_reason: The candidate changes only Python allocator source, tests, and reports; no C++, FlyDSL, or other native source changed. Loaded allocator and kernel wrapper paths were both under /job/repo/python.
remaining_limitations: The assigned accelerator was AMD MI350X/gfx950 with ROCm 7.2, not the issue's NVIDIA A100/CUDA 12.8 environment; CUDA-specific physical illegal-address behavior was not reproduced or claimed.

Validation was allocator-focused and did not run a full model, HTTP serving workload, semantic-accuracy evaluation, or multi-node workload; none is needed to establish the Python-to-kernel ordering contract.

The prepared checkout initially matched the recorded base exactly. origin/main had advanced to a207786205bff0919eb2c8c9126c67f302ccff34 during review, but the required failing-before comparison and candidate parent are both the recorded base.
